sources.summary: Dezeen School Shows: a contemporary furniture collection that puts a twist on the classic look of traditional Parisian pieces is among the projects showcased at this year's New Designers. Also featured are playful seating for children and an accessible toaster with large buttons, designed to be suitable for all ages.
